model: Asset-Level Five-Lens Probability-Adjusted Economic Valuation Model

confidence.replacementCost: Seller-side reconstruction estimate rather than an independently audited all-in cost study.
confidence.marketComparableProxy: Sector-informed analytical proxy; direct subject-asset comparability is not established.
confidence.incomeLicensingProxy: Analytical monetization proxy; buyer-specific cash flow and royalty evidence is not established.
confidence.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Modelled using maturity, commercialization, rights and time-risk assumptions.

definitions.replacementCost: Seller-side estimate for recreating comparable present work product; supporting lens only.
definitions.marketComparableProxy: Modelled marketability indication using maturity, potential and sector context; not a verified precedent-transaction valuation.
definitions.incomeLicensingProxy: Modelled monetization indication; not a DCF or relief-from-royalty valuation.
definitions.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Replacement-cost anchored opportunity value adjusted for technical completion, commercialization probability, rights-transfer reserve, time/risk and sector context.
definitions.triangulatedEconomicReference: Weighted preliminary seller-side analytical reference combining the four valuation lenses; not certified market value.
definitions.sellerAsk: Indicative seller-side acquisition asking reference, separately underwritten from the analytical value model.
